0022600214.text: The Miami Heat (4-6, one-game winning streak, 3-3 on the road) visit the Utah Jazz (1-9, eight straight losses, 1-4 at home) for Miami's 11th game of the season, with the Heat 8th in the East and 2nd in the Southeast, 2 games back. For Miami, Giannis Antetokounmpo (wrist sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision after averaging 27.5 points and 32.8 minutes per game this season. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Keyonte George (ankle sprain), all out, while Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and Utah won the last meeting 115-111 in Miami on February 9, 2026, with no games yet between them in 2026-27.
